blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Emergencies can occur where there is no phone signal and no ambulance nearby. A small language model on a phone can be helpful in such situations, but its advice needs to be safe and accurate. We built HandsOnAid, a 4-bit Gemma 2B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on FirstAidQA dataset, a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question-answer pairs. We compared seven configurations, including the base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned models, and versions with a length floor, safety gate, or retrieval. We used a 41-pair question-answer bank with medically reviewed references that followed ANZCOR guidelines, and a strict 0-5 score rubric, with twelve safety overrides. Four frontier LLM judges (GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3) blindly scored every answer, with 45 hidden controls used to check judge reliability. Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34. The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. A medical professional also conducted a blind evaluation of 40 answers across the base, the 4-bit fine-tuned, and the retrieval configurations, and the scores were similar to the LLM judges' average scores. A keyword audit found limited coverage of several details of ANZCOR guidelines in the training corpus, that are required by the rubric, which suggests that missing information in the training data could be a cause of the low scores. On a smartphone device (Pixel 7 Pro) with six CPU threads and no network connection, the 4-bit fine-tuned model produced its first displayable text in 6.86 seconds and a complete answer in 14.88 seconds on average over ten questions.
blocks.zh: 如果附近没有电话信号和救护车,就可能发生紧急情况。 电话上的一个小语言模型在这种情况下可以有所帮助,但其建议需要安全和准确. 我们建造了HandsOnAid,一个4位的Gemma 2B模型在FirstAidQA数据集上与QLORA进行了微调,共5,550个急救问答对. 我们比较了7个配置,包括基座,4位和8位微调模型,以及带有长地板,安全门或检索的版本. 我们使用了41页的答题库 里面有医检参考书 遵循ANZCOR准则 和严格的0 -5分分号 12个安全标准 四位前沿LLM评委(GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.3)盲分出每个答案,45个隐蔽控制用于检查判断可靠性. 微调后将平均分数从基数模型的+1.08提高到2.34. 最佳配置在5分中得分2.51分,这是有检索功能的微调4位模型. 一名医学专业人员还对整个基地的40个答案进行了盲目评价,4位微调,以及检索配置,分数与LLM评委的平均分数相似. 一项关键词审计发现,培训大纲中对ANZCOR准则若干细节的涵盖范围有限,这是标题所要求的,这表明培训数据中缺少信息可能是分数低的原因。 在一个有6个CPU线程而无网络连接的智能手机设备(Pixel 7 Pro)上,4位微调模型以6.86秒的速度出出第一个可显示文本,并在14.88秒平均回答超过10个问题.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Most AI assistants run on servers, but first aid is often needed where servers cannot be reached: after an earthquake, a cyclone, on a boat, in a forest or isolated place, or when the network is down. In these moments, the person with a phone may be the only help a patient gets. A small language model running on the phone could guide them through the situation, but it must be accurate and safe. A wrong step in an emergency, such as during CPR or moving someone with a spinal injury incorrectly can be dangerous.
blocks.zh: 大多数AI助手运行在服务器上,但在服务器无法到达的情况下往往需要急救:地震后,气旋,乘船,森林或孤立的地方,或者网络衰落时. 此时此刻,有电话的人可能是患者获得的唯一帮助. 一个在电话上运行的小型语言模型可以引导他们渡过困境,但必须准确和安全. 在紧急情况下采取错误的步骤,如在心肺复苏期间或不正确地移动脊椎损伤者,可能是危险的。

blocks.en: We built and tested such a model. HandsOnAid is Gemma 2B ( Gemma Team et al., 2024 ) , a small open model, fine-tuned with QLoRA ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) on FirstAidQA ( Muna et al., 2025 ) , a corpus of 5,550 first-aid question–answer pairs. We also tested ways to get more from a small model: running the base weights at 8-bit instead of 4-bit, generating longer answers, adding a safety gate that checks the answer before giving it as output, and adding retrieval so the model sees a similar training example before answering. In total, we compared seven configurations (tab:configs).
blocks.zh: 我们建造并测试了这样一个模型。 HandsOnAid is Gemma 2B(Gemma Team et al., 2024),一个小型开放型号,在FirstAidQA(Muna et al., 2025)上与QLORA(Dettmers et al., 2023)进行了微调,共5,550个急救问答对. 我们还测试了从一个小模型中获得更多东西的方法:以8位而不是4位运行基重,生成更长的答案,在作为输出给出之前添加一个检查答案的安全门,并添加检索,因此模型在回答之前看到一个类似的训练实例. 我们总共比较了七个配置(tab:configs).

blocks.en: To test them, we wrote 41 emergency question-answer pairs with the help of Claude Fable 5, none copied from the training corpus. Each followed ANZCOR guidelines ( Australian and New Zealand Committee on Resuscitation, 2023 ) and was checked by a medical professional. We also wrote a strict rubric: a 5 means a complete protocol that a layperson could follow alone, while one dangerous instruction can bring the score down to 0 or 1. Four frontier language models: GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro and GLM-5.3, scored every answer without knowing which configuration produced it. We also mixed in 45 control answers to check whether the LLM judges were actually following the rubric. This was followed by a medical professional’s evaluation on a subset of 40 answers across four configurations, and the scores were close to the LLM judges’ averages.
blocks.zh: 为了测试它们,我们在克劳德·福尔5的帮助下写了41个紧急问答对,没有抄袭到训练馆. 每一个都遵循ANZCOR准则(澳大利亚和新西兰复苏委员会,2023年),并由一名医疗专业人员检查。 我们还写了一个严格的标题:一个5意味着一个非专业人员可以独自遵循的完整协议,而一个危险的指令可以使分数降到0或1. 四种前沿语言模型:GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, 深层搜索 V4 Pro和GLM-5.3,在不知哪个配置产生它的情况下,给每个答案打分. 我们还混合了45个控制答案 来检查LLM评委是否真的跟随这个标题 之后,医学专业人员对四个组合的40个回答子集进行了评价,得分接近LLM评委的平均数。

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning helped. It raised the mean score by 1.08 points over the base model to 2.34 on the 0–5 scale. But the best configuration scored only 2.51 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval. Evaluation by a medical professional also showed similar results. Our corpus audit found
few matches for several details of ANZCOR guidelines needed for a top score. This gap suggests that the limitation in training data could contribute to the low scores.
blocks.zh:
微调帮助。 它将比基模高1.08分的平均值提升到0比5的2.34分. 但最佳配置只得2.51分,这是有检索功能的微调4位模型. 一名医学专业人员的评估也显示出类似的结果。 我们的调查发现
为获得最高分,ANZCOR准则的若干细节很少匹配。 这一差距表明,培训数据方面的限制可能助长低分。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Large models contain substantial clinical knowledge ( Singhal et al., 2023 ) , and
benchmarks such as MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, BioASQ, and MedQuAD measure it ( Jin et al., 2021 ; Pal et al., 2022 ; Jin et al., 2019 ; Tsatsaronis et al., 2015 ; Ben Abacha and Demner-Fushman, 2019 ) ,
mostly through multiple-choice or encyclopedic questions. None focuses on
step-by-step guidance that a layperson must follow in a short time. EMSQA covers
emergency-services exam questions and shows that retrieval helps ( Ge et al., 2026 ) ; FirstAidQA focuses on first aid in low-connectivity settings ( Muna et al., 2025 ) and is our corpus. These benchmarks generally assume
professional care is reachable, so “call emergency services” can be a good
answer. In our setting, an answer that only says to call emergency services is
penalized if it mentions no action that is possible to carry out in that scenario.
blocks.zh:
大型模型包含大量的临床知识(Singhal等人,2023年),以及
诸如MedQA、MedMCQA、PubMedQA、BioASQ和MedQuAD等基准测量它(Jin等人,2021年;Pal等人,2022年;Jin等人,2019年;Tsatsaronis等人,2015年;Ben Abacha和Demner-Fushman,2019年),
大多通过多选题或百科全书题. 无重点
非专业人员必须在短期内遵循的逐步指导。 EMSQA 覆盖
紧急服务考试问题并表明检索有帮助(Ge等人,2026年); " 质量评估 " 的重点是在低连接性环境下的急救(Muna等人,2025年),这是我们的工具。 这些基准一般假定:
专业护理是可以达到的,因此“呼叫急救服务”可以是一种良好的
答问. 在我们的环境下,一个只说呼叫紧急服务的答案是:
如果它提到在这种情况下不可能采取的行动,则将受到惩罚。

blocks.en:
There are existing first-aid apps that provide offline guidance. The American Red Cross
app, for example, provides preloaded instructions ( American Red Cross, 2026 ) on specific topics. A language model could answer a question phrased
in the user’s own words and adapt its wording to the situation, which can be unknown and not covered in a preloaded library. We study this
gap.
blocks.zh:
现有急救应用提供线下指导. 美国红十字会
例如,app提供预装指令(美国红十字会,2026年)针对特定主题. 一个语言模型可以回答一个问题短语
在用户自己的文字中,并调整其措辞以适应情况,这种情况可能是未知的,并且没有在预装的库中覆盖。 我们研究这个
间隙.

blocks.en:
Small open models ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) have been adapted for medicine ( Han et al., 2023 ) , used on phones ( Li and others, 2025 ) , and tuned from
Gemma ( Sellergren et al., 2025 ) . We use QLoRA with a
4-bit model ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) . It is unclear whether quantisation
can make medical answers less safe ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Egashira et al., 2024 ) . We test its effect.
blocks.zh:
小型开放型号(张等,2024年)已改编为医学型号(韩等,2023年),在手机上使用(李等,2025年),调制自 .
Gemma(Sellergren等人,2025年). 我们使用QLORA与一个
4位模型(Dettmers等人,2023年). 不清楚是否量化
(Hong等人,2024年;Egashira等人,2024年) 我们测试它的效果。

blocks.en:
MedRAG studies medical retrieval over large biomedical datasets ( Xiong et al., 2024 ) , including BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) technique. We retrieve one relevant
pair from the FirstAidQA corpus during inference. This tests whether showing a
training example helps at inference time for a better response ( 7 ).
blocks.zh:
MedraG研究大型生物医学数据集的医疗检索(Xiong等人,2024年),包括BM25技术(Robertson和Zaragoza,2009年)。 我们找到一个相关的
在推论中从FirstAidQA acidities中找到一对。 此测试是否显示
培训实例有助于推论时间作出更好的反应(7)。

blocks.en:
Using a large model to evaluate another model is efficient ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) ,
but LLM judges may favor their own answers and score differently from experts ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . We use four judges from
different model families and evaluate answers blindly at temperature zero. No
judge is from the same family as the model being tested. We also test whether score differences are statistically significant ( Verga et al., 2024 ; Dror et al., 2018 ) . As in prior safety benchmarks ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Ness et al., 2024 ; Pal et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) ,
we report quality scores and safety flags separately. Also, self-revision can help ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) , but may fail without outside feedback ( Huang et al., 2024 ) ; our safety-gate results show the same.
blocks.zh:
使用大型模型来评价另一个模型是高效的(郑等人,2023年),,
但LLM评委可能倾向于自己的答案,得分与专家不同(Paniksery等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年)。 我们用四名法官
不同的模范家庭 在零温下盲目评估答案 没有
法官与被测试的模型来自同一家庭。 我们还测试得分差异在统计学上是否显著(Verga等人,2024年;Dror等人,2018年). 与先前的安全基准一样(Chen等人,2025年;Ness等人,2024年;Pal等人,2023年;Wang等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年),
我们分别报告质量分数和安全旗。 另外,自译自审也可以有所帮助(Madaan等人,2023年),但可能在没有外界反馈的情况下失败(Huang等人,2024年);我们的安全门结果显示相同.

blocks.en:
Synthetic medical datasets are often checked to see if their answers are clear
and believable, following the Self-Instruct approach ( Wang et al., 2023 ) .
For our setting, a separate question is guideline coverage : whether
the data includes the steps required by the chosen evaluation standard. 7 shows why that matters.
blocks.zh:
常检查合成医学数据集,看其答案是否清楚
且信之,循自授之法(王等,2023年).
就我们而言,另一个问题是准则范围: 是否为
数据包括选定的评价标准所要求的步骤。 7显示这有什么关系。

blocks.en: 3 Dataset, Model and Configurations
blocks.zh: 3 数据集、模型和配置

blocks.en:
The corpus has 5,550 question–answer pairs, available on Hugging Face. Answers are short and practical, averaging 44 words. We added two labels: each
pair was given one of ten clinical categories ( A ) and
marked safety-critical (SC) when it involved a life-threatening situation.
We used a DeBERTaV3
cross-encoder trained on SNLI and MultiNLI, for zero-shot SC labelling through
natural language inference ( He et al., 2023 ; Sentence Transformers, 2026 ; Yin et al., 2019 ) ( F ). The SC rate is 22.2% in the full corpus and 22.4% in
the training split. We split the data into 4,441 / 556 / 553 training,
validation, and test pairs, while keeping the category mix similar across
splits.
blocks.zh:
人身保护令共有5,550个问答,可在Hugging Face上查阅。 答案简短实用,平均44个字. 我们增加了两个标签:
双胞胎是10个临床类别之一(A)和
在涉及危及生命的情况下,标记安全临界值。
我们用DeBERTAV3
在SNLI和MultiNLI上接受过零射SC标签培训的交叉编码器
自然语言推论(He等人,2023年;判决变换器,2026年); Yin et al., 2019) (法语). 在册种姓比率为:全族22.2%;
训练分开。 我们把数据分为4,441/556/553培训,
验证和测试对,同时保持类别组合的相似性
分数。

blocks.en:
We use QLoRA ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) : the base model is kept frozen at 4-bit
precision, while LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) adds small trainable matrices. We add
these matrices to all seven projection sites in every layer, including the
feed-forward layers, because first-aid answers need the right content ,
such as correct quantities and step order, not just good attention. We calculate
the loss only for answer tokens. The main settings are rank 16, alpha 32,
learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} with a cosine schedule, and a maximum length of 320
tokens (full table in B ). Training took 75 minutes on one
12 GB GPU and stopped at epoch 2.88, with a validation loss of 1.340.
Fine-tuning also made the answers much shorter: 43 words on average (similar to the corpus), compared
with 134 for the base model.
blocks.zh:

符号(完整的B表). 一次训练75分钟
12GB GPU在2.88号时停运,验证损失为1.340.
微调也使答案短得多:平均43个字(类似于本体),比较
与134个基数模型。

blocks.en:
The retrieval configurations (F & G) search the 4,441 training pairs using
BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) . We place the best matching pair before the
question as a reference. We use keyword matching because
emergency questions are short, and specific words like “tourniquet” can help find the
right answer. A gate turns retrieval off for seven topics where the corpus has
gaps or potentially misleading examples ( D ). The knowledge base is the training set,
so the retrieved text adds no external source material. This was done to check whether having the context of a
relevant training example makes the model generate better answers.
blocks.zh:
检索配置( F & G) 搜索4 441 个培训对
BM25(罗伯逊和萨拉戈萨,2009年). 我们把最好的配对 之前
问题作为参考。 我们使用关键字匹配,因为
紧急问题很短,“止血带”等具体词语有助于找到
正确的答案。 一个门关闭了对七个主题的检索 程序有
空白或潜在误导性实例(D.) 知识库是训练集,
因此检索的文本没有添加外部源材料。 这样做是为了检查是否具有下列背景:
相关的培训实例使模型产生更好的答案。

fig:pipeline shows the whole
study at a glance and tab:configs lists the 7 configurations.
blocks.zh:
fig: 管道显示整个

blocks.en:
The length floor (D) gives the model one more try when its answer is too short,
with a hint to be more thorough, and keeps the longer answer ( B ). The safety gate (E)
checks the answer against danger rules and labels it safe or unsafe . If unsafe, the answer is
replaced with a fixed generic message telling the user to keep the person still, watch
their breathing and responsiveness, and give no food, drink, or medication.
blocks.zh:
长度地板(D)让模型在答案太短时再试一次,
并保持较长的答案(B )。 安全门(E)
对照危险规则检查答案并标注安全或不安全。 如果不安全,答案是
替换为一个固定的通用信件, 告诉用户不要动, 看
他们的呼吸和反应, 并且不给食物,饮料,或药物。

blocks.en: 4 How We Evaluated
blocks.zh: 4 我们如何评价

blocks.en: 4.1 The 41-question exam
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 41题考试

blocks.en:
We created 41 new question-answer pairs with the help of Claude Fable 5, covering the ten corpus
categories in similar proportions ( A ). Eleven (26.8%) are safety-critical, compared with
22.2% in the corpus, and none was copied from it. Each question has a
reference answer based on ANZCOR guidelines ( Australian and New Zealand Committee on Resuscitation, 2023 ) . We chose ANZCOR as an established guideline to provide a consistent evaluation standard, as there must be no room for errors in emergency situations. The answers
start with the action to take and include exact numbers, such as placing a
tourniquet 5–7 cm above the wound, cooling a burn for 20 minutes, etc.
blocks.zh:
在克劳德5号的帮助下,我们创造了41个新的回答对, 覆盖了10个字母
类似比例的类别(A.) 11人(26.8%)的安全至关重要,而
里面有22.2%,没有从中复制。 每个问题都有
基于ANZCOR准则的参考答复(澳大利亚和新西兰复苏委员会,2023年)。 我们选择ANZCOR作为提供一致评价标准的既定准则,因为在紧急情况下不得有错误。 答案( 答案 )
从要采取的行动开始,并包括确切数字,例如设置
止血带在伤口上方5-7厘米处,冷却燃烧20分钟等.

blocks.en:
A medical professional reviewed every question and reference against ANZCOR in
two rounds (tab:review). The first round reported 12 minor
issues. We revised the references after this review. The second round
scored 4.0 for safety, 4.5 for relevance and 4.0 for accuracy, out of 5. We also shortened the references to an average of 54 words, close to the corpus average of 44 words. One reference excerpt from the bank:
blocks.zh:
一名医学专业人员审查了针对ANZCOR的每个问题和参考资料,并称:
2轮( Tab: review). 第一轮报告为12个未成年人
问题。 在本次审查之后,我们修改了参考资料。 第二轮
安全分4.0分,适切分4.5分,精度分4.0分5分. 我们还缩短了平均54个字的提法,接近平均44个字。 银行的一份参考摘录:

blocks.en: 4.2 The rubric
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 标题

blocks.en:
Four LLM judges score each answer from 0 to 5. A 5 means the answer is correct, complete,
and clear enough for someone to follow on their own. A 4 has small gaps but remains safe. A 3 misses one
or two important steps. A 2 is too general or incomplete, while 1 contains
dangerous or misleading advice. A 0 is wrong or empty. An answer
that only says “call emergency services” cannot score above 2.
blocks.zh:
4位LLM评委每分从0分到5分. A5表示答案正确,完整,
并且足够清晰 让人能独自跟随 4号车的缺口很小,但仍然安全。 3个漏了一个
或两个重要步骤。 A 2 过于笼统或不完整,而 1 包含
危险或误导性的建议。 0是错的还是空的. 一个答案
只说“呼叫紧急服务”不能超过2分。

blocks.en:
We also use twelve safety overrides , such as removing an embedded object,
moving a suspected spinal injury without a log-roll, removing a tourniquet,
giving food or water to an unconscious person, and using abdominal thrusts for
choking ( C ). If an answer includes
any of these, it must score 0 or 1, even if the rest of the answer is good. Each answer is judged twice: once for quality (0–5 score
with a reason) and once for safety (yes/no for each override, with the unsafe
phrase quoted).
blocks.zh:
我们还使用12个安全控制器,例如移除嵌入式物体,
移动疑似脊椎损伤,没有记录卷,去除止血带,
向无意识的人提供食物或水,并利用腹部推力
窒息 (C). 如果一个答案包括:
任何这些,它必须得分0或1,即使其余的答案是好的. 每个答题都要判两次:一次质量(0-5分)
有原因的),并出于安全考虑一次(每一次是/否,不安全的
页:1

blocks.en: 4.3 The four judges and the control answers
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 四位法官以及控制方的答案

blocks.en:
We use four frontier models from different vendors as judges: DeepSeek V4 Pro,
Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and GLM-5.3. Gemini was excluded because it shares
the Gemma family (from Google). Judging is blind: we replace configuration names with salted
hashes and score each answer separately using the question, safety-critical
flag, reference answer, and rubric. All judges use temperature zero and JSON
output. We froze and recorded the prompts before scoring. Each judge made 664
calls, all of which returned valid responses.
blocks.zh:
我们使用来自不同供应商的四种前沿模式作为法官: 深搜索 V4 专业
Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, 和 GLM-5.3. 双子座被排除在外 因为它分享
Gemma家族(来自Google). 判断是盲目的: 我们用盐名替换配置名称
使用安全关键题, 将每个回答分别进行散开和评分
旗帜,参考答案,和标题。 所有裁判都使用零温和JSON
输出。 在评分前,我们冻结并记录了提示。 每个法官做了664人
电话,所有电话都回复有效。

blocks.en:
To check the judges, we mixed 45 control answers with the real answers. These
included the reference answer (must score 4–5), an answer that only says to
call emergency services (0–2), a clear-sounding but unhelpful answer (0–3),
and six answers with one deliberate dangerous instruction (0–1). The safety
check also had to flag each dangerous instruction. All four judges scored all
45 controls in the correct range and caught all 6 planted violations, which covered five of the twelve
override categories. On real
answers, any two judges agreed exactly 53–64% of the time and were within just 1 point difference 92–98% of the time.
blocks.zh:
为了检查法官 我们把45个控制答案和真实答案混为一谈 这些
包括参考答案(必须得分4-5),这一答案只表示
呼叫紧急服务(0-2),一个清晰但无益的答案(0-3),
和六个回答,一个故意的危险指示(0-1)。 保险
检查还必须标出每个危险指示。 四位评委都得分了
45个控制范围正确,并发现所有6起违反事件,其中5起涉及12起
覆盖分类 。 真实的
任何两位法官都同意时间的53-64%,而且时间只有92%-98%的1点差。

blocks.en: 4.4 Statistics
blocks.zh: 4.4 统计

blocks.en:
We tested each judge separately using a paired
bootstrap and an exact sign test over the 41 questions. We call a difference
confirmed only if both tests pass for all four judges and they all
agree on its direction.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个对子分别测试了每个法官
靴子和准确的标志测试 在41个问题。 我们称之为不同
只有所有四位法官都通过考试 才能确认
同意它的方向。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:
We tested seven configurations on the same 41 questions and scored the answers using the four frontier LLM judges. tab:results gives
the means and tab:contrasts shows statistical comparisons.
blocks.zh:
我们在同一41个问题上测试了7个配置,并使用4个前沿LLM评委对答案进行了评分. 选项卡:结果
手段和标签:连续符显示统计比较。

blocks.en:
The fine-tuned 4-bit model scores 1.08 points higher than the base model. It does
better on 34 of 41 questions and worse on only 5. All four judges found a similar improvement: DeepSeek V4 Pro + 1.02 +1.02 , Claude Opus 5 + 1.34 +1.34 ,
GPT-5.6 Sol + 0.90 +0.90 , and GLM-5.3 + 1.05 +1.05 . Answers with an override
flagged by at least one judge drop from 16 to 9, while the average answer length drops from 134 to 43 words,
close to the 44-word average in FirstAidQA. Fine-tuning still helps when
retrieval is added: the base model with retrieval (G) scores more than 1 point lower than the fine-tuned
model with retrieval (F), and almost 1 point
lower than the fine-tuned model alone (B).
blocks.zh:
微调4位模型得分比基准模型高1.08分. 没错
在41个问题中,34个问题比较好,只有5个问题比较好。 所有四名法官都发现了类似的改进:DeepSeek V4 Pro + 1.02 + 1.02,Claude Opus 5 + 1.34 + 1.34 + 1.34,
GPT-5.6 Sol + 0.90 + 0.90,以及 GLM-5.3 + 1.05 + 1.05 . 带有超文本的回答
至少有一名法官标注的词从16个降为9个,平均回答长度从134个字降为43个字,
接近FirstAidQA中44字平均值. 微调还是有帮助的
添加检索:具有检索(G)分数比微调低1分以上的基础模型
带有检索(F)和近1点的模型
低于光是微调模型(B).

blocks.en:
Adding retrieval to the fine-tuned model (F) gives the best mean score, 2.51
out of 5, but the gain over B is small ( + 0.17 +0.17 ). The 8-bit
model (C), length floor (D), and safety gate (E) also show little difference
in this experiment. We use
4-bit for deployment because it is smaller and faster.
The safety gate has the fewest answers flagged by all four judges (2), but
9 are flagged by at least one judge. Its generic fallback can score at most
2. Retrieval without
fine-tuning (G) scores 1.39 and has 19 answers flagged by at least one judge.
blocks.zh:
在微调模型(F)中添加检索给出最佳平均分,2.51
出局 5, 但比 B 的增益很小( + 0. 17 + 0. 17 ) 。 8 位
型号(C)、长地板(D)和安全门(E)也几乎没有区别
在这个实验中。 我们用
4位用于部署,因为它越来越小和更快.
安全门的答案最少 由所有四个法官标出(2),但
至少有一名法官标出9个标记。 它的通用回落最多可以得分
2. 无
微调(G)分1.39分,有至少一名法官标出19个答案。

blocks.en:
The medical professional who reviewed the 41-pair reference bank later also evaluated a subset of
40 answers: we chose answers to the same ten questions from each of configurations A, B, F and G. These configurations
involve fine-tuning and/or retrieval; C, D and E were not included because their mean scores differed little from B. The subset covered seven
categories, with four safety-critical questions out of the ten. Answers were
shuffled and configuration identities were hidden. The evaluator received the
references and rubric, checked the twelve overrides, and assigned 0–5 scores.
blocks.zh:
稍后审查41页参考库的医务专业人员也评估了以下几部分:
40个答案:我们从A,B,F和G三个构型中选择了相同的十个问题的答案. 这些配置
不包括C、D和E,因为它们的中间分数与B的分数差别不大。 该子集涵盖7个
类别,在10个类别中有4个安全关键问题。 答复是:
洗牌和配置身份被隐藏. 评价员收到
参考文献和标题,检查12个覆盖,并给出0-5分。

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning improved the human mean by 1.00 point, while retrieval added
0.10 points to the fine-tuned model (tab:human). Scores given by the medical professional were similar (bit higher but not significantly), and the configuration ordering matched the LLM means on this
subset.
blocks.zh:
微调将人的平均值提高了1.00分,同时增加了检索
0.10指微调模型(tab:human). 医学专业人员给出的分数相似(比特高但并不显著),为此订购的配置符合LLM手段
子集。

blocks.en: 6 On-Device Performance
blocks.zh: 6 设备性能

blocks.en:
We evaluated the 4-bit fine-tuned model locally on a Google
Pixel 7 Pro using Termux and llama.cpp ( Gerganov, 2023 ) , with CPU
inference. We used a subset of the same ten questions for the four and six-thread
runs, temperature 0, seed 42, a 1,024-token context, a 350-token generation
limit, and no prompt cache. Airplane mode was enabled, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
were off, and the charger was disconnected.
blocks.zh:
我们在谷歌上评估了4位微调模型
像素 7 Pro使用Termux和lama.cpp(Gerganov,2023年),带有CPU.
推论. 我们用一个子集 相同的10个问题 四和六条
运行,温度0,种子42,上下文为1 024,一代为350
限制,没有快速缓存。 启用了飞机模式, Wi-Fi 和 Bluetooth
充电器断开

blocks.en:
With six threads, answers averaged 47.8 words, began appearing after
6.86 seconds, and finished after 14.88 seconds
(tab:phone). These results demonstrate offline
model inference on the tested phone.
blocks.zh:
有六个线索,答案平均为47.8字,开始出现于
6.86秒,14.88秒后完成
(塔布:电话). 这些结果表明离线
模型推论在测试手机。

blocks.en: 7 Why Scores Are Low
blocks.zh: 7 为什么得分低

blocks.en:
The best configuration (F) scores 2.51 out of 5. The judges were not simply being
strict: they gave every planted reference control answer a 5. So why are the model
scores low?
blocks.zh:
最佳配置(F)在5. 法官们不只是
严格:他们给每个植入的参考控制回答一个5。 那么,为什么模型
分数低?

blocks.en: 7.1 The rubric is strict by design
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 上面的标语很严格

blocks.en:
fig:bands shows how the scores are distributed. For the best
configuration (F), the 164 judge scores were: • 0–1: 13.4% — unsafe, wrong, or triggered a safety override. • 2: 28.7% — generic or incomplete. • 3–4: 57.9% — partially or mostly complete. • 5: 0% — complete under the rubric.
blocks.zh:
fig:带显示分数的分配方式. 为了最好
配置(F),164名法官的分数是: ^ 0–1: 13.4% – 不安全,错误,或引发安全超标. • 2:28.7%——通用或不完整。 • 3-4:57.9%——部分或大部分完成。 • 5:0%——在标题下完成。

blocks.en: 0–1: 13.4% — unsafe, wrong, or triggered a safety override.
blocks.zh: 0–1: 13.4% — 不安全,错误,或引发安全覆盘.

blocks.en: 2: 28.7% — generic or incomplete.
3–4: 57.9% — partially or mostly complete.
5: 0% — complete under the rubric.
blocks.zh: 5:0%——在标题下完成.

blocks.en:
For the fine-tuned model alone (B), these were 25.0%, 29.9%, 44.5%, and
0.6%. For the base model (A), they were 64.6%, 27.4%, 7.9%, and 0%.
Fine-tuning reduced the share of 0–1 ratings from 64.6% to 25.0%.
However, no answer was considered complete by three
of the four judges; the only score of 5 came from GLM-5.3.
blocks.zh:
仅微调模型(B)就占25.0%、29.9%、44.5%;
0.6%。 基准型号(A)为64.6%、27.4%、7.9%和0%。
微调将0–1收视率从64.6%降至25.0%.
但是,3个国家认为没有答复完整。
4名法官中,只有5名来自GLM-5.3。

blocks.en: 7.2 Some rubric details are rarely matched in the corpus
blocks.zh: 第7.2条 一些标点细节很少与本体相匹配

blocks.en:
Neither FirstAidQA nor its source book mentions about the ANZCOR guidelines used in our evaluation. Because we use this specific standard, our evaluation requires specific numbers and steps. A keyword audit of the
4,441 training answers found no matches for two of these details and only
three for the 30:2 CPR ratio (tab:anchors). For
choking, ANZCOR requires back blows followed by chest thrusts. However, the
corpus mentions chest thrusts only once, while abdominal thrusts or the Heimlich
manoeuvre (a different choking technique) appear 41 times.
blocks.zh:
也没有第一援助 " 质量保证 " 及其来源书提到了我们评价中使用的ANZCOR准则。 由于我们使用这一具体标准,我们的评估需要具体的数目和步骤。 关键词审计
4 441份培训答复中找不到两个细节的匹配数据,只有
30:2的心肺复苏比率为3(tab:anchors)。 对于
窒息,ANZCOR需要背部的打击,然后是胸部的推力。 然而,
尸体只提到一次胸部推力 腹部推力或海姆利希
机动(一种不同的窒息技术)出现41次。

blocks.en: 7.3 The same questions that fail in every configuration
blocks.zh: 第7.3条 每个配置都失败的相同问题

blocks.en:
Seven low-scoring questions show the same pattern. Six are safety-critical, and
in every configuration, the SC mean (average score on the 11
safety-critical questions only) is lower than the overall mean. The two lowest-scoring questions are also found in the
corpus audit. On the tourniquet question, the fine-tuned 4-bit model says:
blocks.zh:
7个低评分问题显示了相同的模式. 六是安全关键
在每种配置中,SC平均值(11的平均分数)
(仅安全关键问题)低于总平均值。 两个得分最低的问题也载于
实体审计。 关于止血带问题,微调4位模型说:

blocks.en:
“If the bleeding has persisted for ten minutes without improvement, apply
additional pressure for 10–20 minutes. If the bleeding continues, repeat the
process. If the person becomes unconscious or shows signs of shock, begin CPR
immediately.”
blocks.zh:
“如果出血持续10分钟,没有改善,则适用
额外压力10-20分钟。 如果继续流血,请重复
进程。 如果该人失去知觉或表现出休克的迹象,则开始心肺复苏
马上 “

blocks.en:
All four judges flag the same problem: the bleeding has not stopped, but the
model never says to use a tourniquet. On the choking question, it says to
“begin CPR immediately” for a conscious adult, skipping back blows and chest
thrusts. All four judges flag this too. These failures are consistent with the gaps
found in the corpus audit.
blocks.zh:
所有四位法官都标出了同样的问题: 流血没有停止,
模特儿从没说过要用止血带 关于窒息的问题,它说
为有意识的成年人“立即开始心肺复苏”,跳过背部的打击和胸部
推力 推力 推力 所有四位法官都标注着这个 这些失败与差距是一致的
调查中发现的

blocks.en: 7.4 Limits of the retrieval and safety gate
blocks.zh: 7.4 检索和安全门的限制

blocks.en:
Retrieval helps only when the corpus has a good answer to find. Compared with the fine-tuned model alone, it improved
four questions by 1.25–1.75 points but made four others worse by 0.75–1.0
points. What mattered was whether
the retrieved record was correctly following ANZCOR guidelines or not. We did not use a different source or corpus for retrieval because that might have fetched different answers to what the model already knew through its training, and then it might get confused or hallucinate while answering.
blocks.zh:
只有在被调查人有好答案时 检索才有帮助 仅与微调模型相比,改进了
四个问题比1.25-1.75点差,但使另外四个问题比0.75-1.0差。
点。 重要的是,是否
检索到的记录是否正确遵循了ANZCOR准则。 我们没有使用不同的源或源代码进行检索,因为这可能会得到不同答案,来解答模型在训练中已经知道的东西,然后在回答时可能会产生困惑或幻觉。

blocks.en:
The safety gate replaced answers with its generic fallback message. The fallback can score at most 2. So the
gate can withhold an unsafe answer, but it cannot produce a correct (complete) one.
blocks.zh:
安全门用其通用的倒置信息取代了答案. 倒计时最多得分 2. 因此,
闸门可以拒绝一个不安全的答案,但它不能产生一个正确的(完整的)答案.

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The results show both a benefit from fine-tuning and a gap between the model’s
answers and our evaluation requirements. We chose ANZCOR as a single guideline because wrong first-aid advice can be dangerous, making it important to use a consistent and strict evaluation standard. FirstAidQA dataset was not constructed or
validated using ANZCOR guidelines. Its source book (though it is Australian) does not mention ANZCOR either. This difference in training data is therefore a plausible contributor to the low scores. However,
we tested one corpus and one model only, and cannot
conclude that the corpus alone sets the performance ceiling.
blocks.zh:
结果显示,对模型进行微调和在模型之间有差距。
答案和我们的评估要求。 我们选择ANZCOR作为单一的准则,因为错误的急救建议可能很危险,因此必须使用一致和严格的评价标准。 FirstAidQA数据集未构建或
使用ANZCOR准则验证。 其来源书(虽然是澳大利亚的)也没有提及ANZCOR。 因此,在培训数据方面的这种差异是造成成绩低的一个合理因素。 不过
我们只测试过一个体型和一个模型,不能
得出结论,仅凭授权书就可以确定性能上限。

blocks.en:
The retrieval result has the same limit. It accesses relevant
examples from the same training corpus. The human evaluation
supports the LLM judges’ scores, while the
phone benchmark establishes that the model can run offline on the tested
device.
blocks.zh:
检索结果有相同的限制. 它访问相关的
同一培训机构的例子。 人类评价
支持LLM评分,而
电话基准确定,该模型可在测试后下线运行
设备。

blocks.en: For first-aid datasets, our observations suggest the necessity of following an established protocol and evaluating the proportion of answers that correctly apply them. The dataset should fully align with the selected guideline.
blocks.zh: 对于急救数据集,我们的意见表明,必须遵循既定的协议,并评估正确应用这些协议的答案比例。 数据集应与选定的准则完全一致。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
The best configuration scored only 2.51 out of 5 and encountered safety override
flags, so it is not ready for emergency use.
The reference bank and subset of model answers underwent human evaluation, but that was done by one medical professional only.
blocks.zh:
最佳配置5分中只有2.51分,遇到安全超标
旗帜,所以还没有准备好紧急使用。
参照库和样板答案子集经过了人类评估,但只有一位医学专业人员进行了评估。

blocks.en:
We used one English corpus, one model family, one guideline-based
rubric, and single-turn interactions. The safety-critical labels were given by a language model. Keyword checks
might miss equivalent or paraphrased wording.
blocks.zh:
我们用了一个英国体格,一个模范家庭,一个准则
和单回合的相互作用 安全临界标签由语言模型给出. 关键字检查
可能错失等同措辞或原词。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
We fine-tuned Gemma 2B on FirstAidQA and compared seven configurations on
41 questions with medically reviewed references and four LLM judges.
Fine-tuning improved the mean score by more than a point, and no add-on gave
a significant improvement. The human evaluation produced similar configuration means and the same ordering as the LLM judges. The model ran offline on a
smartphone, taking 6.86 seconds to first text and 14.88 seconds to a complete
answer with six CPU threads. These are useful steps toward studying offline
first-aid assistance, but the low scores mean
HandsOnAid remains a research prototype. The training dataset audit suggests a coverage
problem without establishing it as the only cause of the observed failures. We welcome extension of our work and further involvement of researchers in this field, as emergency response remains a somewhat underexplored domain.
blocks.zh:
我们在FirstAidQA上微调了Gemma 2B 并比较了七个配置
有41个问题,有经医学审查的参考文献和4名法学硕士法官。
精细调整使平均分提高1分以上,没有附加
这是一项重大改进。 人类评价产生了与LLM法官相似的配置手段和订单。 模特儿跑下线了
智能手机,需要6.86秒到第一个文本,14.88秒到完成
用六个CPU线程回答. 这些是离线学习的有益步骤
急救,但低分数意味着
HandsOnAid仍然是研究原型. 培训数据集审计建议涵盖范围
问题不在于将它确定为发现失败的唯一原因。 我们欢迎扩大我们的工作,欢迎研究人员进一步参与这一领域的工作,因为应急反应仍然是一些未得到充分探讨的领域。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: HandsOnAid is not a medical device or a replacement for professional care. When emergency services are available nearby, contacting them should always be the first step, and any deployed system should make this clear. A system scoring 2.51 out of 5 could potentially harm someone who follows its advice. We publish these results because an honest account of the observed failures is useful for future work.
blocks.zh: HandsOnAid不是医疗设备,也不是专业护理的替代。 当附近有紧急服务时,与他们联系总是第一步,任何部署的系统都应明确这一点。 5分中得2.51分的系统可能会伤害听从其建议的人。 我们公布这些结果是因为诚实地叙述所观察到的失败对今后的工作是有益的。

blocks.en:
Retrieval is skipped when a query matches any of seven
topic patterns where the corpus has gaps: tourniquet escalation, infant choking, spinal movement or
log-roll, chest seals, naloxone or opioid overdose, drowning rescue breaths,
and burn cooling.

记录卷 胸章 纳氧酮或类阿片过量 溺水呼吸
并烧焦。

The retrieved pair is inserted as a labelled block between the instruction and
the question:

blocks.en:
Configuration E checks for spinal movement without a log-roll, embedded-object

medication, food or water for an unconscious person, a four-sided chest seal,

before drowning compressions.
An unsafe verdict, or an empty initial answer, causes replacement
with a fixed fallback message; otherwise the original answer is retained.

blocks.en: Appendix E Judging Protocol Details
blocks.zh: 附录E 判断协议细节

blocks.en:
332 items per judge: 287 real answers (7
configurations × \times 41 questions) plus 45 planted controls. Each item is
scored under two frozen prompts, quality (integer 0–5 with a reason) and
safety (a yes/no verdict for each of the twelve overrides, with a quoted unsafe
phrase). That is 664 calls per judge.
blocks.zh:
每个法官332项:287项实际答复(7项)
配置 ×\times 41 问)+ 45 植入控件. 每个项目是
在两个冷冻提示下得分,质量(整数 0-5有原因)和
安全(对12项指令中的每一项判定是/否,引用不安全)
语句)。 每位法官有664个电话

blocks.en:
For 13 questions (7 SC, 6 non-SC), we planted the
verbatim reference (expected score 4–5), an EMS-only answer (0–2), and a fluent
but unhelpful answer (0–3). Six of these questions also received an answer with a deliberate
override violation (0–1). This was done to test adherence to the rubric and detection of planted violations. All four judges
passed all 45 score-range checks and caught all six violations.

覆盖违反( 0– 1) 。 这样做是为了检验是否遵守规定,并查明已制造的侵犯行为。 所有四名法官
通过所有45分的检查 并发现所有6次违规。

blocks.en: Appendix F Safety-Critical Labelling
blocks.zh: 附录F 安全标志

blocks.en:
We used cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-small , a DeBERTaV3
cross-encoder for the SC labelling. The NLI input concatenated the question and answer. The two candidate labels
were a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate first aid
intervention and a non-urgent first aid question or general medical
information . The higher-scoring label determined the binary
SC flag.

我们用了跨编码器/nli-deberta-v3-small,一个DeBERTaV3
SC标签的交叉编码器。 NLI输入调和了问答. 两个候选标签
是一种危及生命的紧急情况,需要立即急救
急救问题或一般医疗
资料. 高分标签决定二进制
SC旗帜.
